# BPExchOnline (bpexchonline.com)

Pakistan service desk for BPExch (the betting exchange also known by its earlier name, BetPro Exchange).
Facts: accounts and IDs are free, issued by the desk via WhatsApp in ~2 minutes; minimum deposit Rs 500;
minimum withdrawal Rs 1,000; payments by Easypaisa, JazzCash and bank transfer (IBFT/Raast); one account
covers the exchange, live casino and Android app; account types: user, dealer, master, super master;
support 24/7 in Urdu and English; desk never requests passwords, wallet PINs or OTPs.
